spec.name: GoldSessionORB_TrendContinuation
spec.hypothesis: Gold exhibits strong intraday momentum driven by institutional macro flows that establish direction during the London open and accelerate during the New York overlap. By identifying the 4-hour trend bias via HTF EMA slope and waiting for a confirmed Break of Structure (BOS) in that direction, we capture the expansion phase of the daily move. The losing side consists of retail mean-reversion traders fading the initial breakout without structural confirmation, as well as late entrants who buy after the liquidity has already been absorbed. Institutional order flow uses the London session to accumulate positions, and the NY session to distribute or drive price to targets.
spec.entry_logic: 1. Determine 4H trend bias using the slope of the 4H 20-period EMA. 2. Confirm a Break of Structure (BOS) on the 1H timeframe in the direction of the 4H bias (bull_bos for longs, bear_bos for shorts). 3. Ensure the current bar falls within the London or New York sessions. 4. Enter in the direction of the BOS and HTF trend.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss is placed at a multiple of the 14-period ATR below/above entry to allow for normal volatility breathing room. Take profit is set at a fixed Risk:Reward ratio defined by the tp_rr parameter. A cooldown of 4 bars prevents immediate re-entry on consecutive BOS signals.
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Protracted low-volatility summer chop or sudden news-driven whipsaws that trigger false BOS signals followed by immediate reversals.

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
